# should-fix (post-P3a re-gate): a checked-in fixture of the expected
# pg_get_expr() text for every row in private.definer_policy_allowlist
# (0016_private_definer.sql), so a migration that changes a policy's
# USING/WITH CHECK clause TOGETHER with its own allow-list row (which
# would otherwise pass 10_function_inventory.sql's test 9 unchanged --
# that test only compares the allow-list row against the LIVE policy,
# and a self-consistent pair of edits satisfies it either way) produces
# a visible diff in review: this file must be regenerated and its diff
# reviewed by hand whenever a private_definer-scoped policy's real
# expression text changes, not just silently re-derived at apply time.
#
# Format: one JSON object per line (JSONL), one per
# private.definer_policy_allowlist row, ordered by
# (schema_name, table_name, policy_name, command). Lines starting with
# '#' are comments, skipped by the reader.
#
# Regenerate after any migration that adds/changes a private_definer
# policy (from a freshly-migrated database):
#   psql -At -c "SELECT jsonb_build_object('schema_name',schema_name,
#     'table_name',table_name,'policy_name',policy_name,'command',command,
#     'using_expr',using_expr,'with_check_expr',with_check_expr)::text
#     FROM private.definer_policy_allowlist
#     ORDER BY schema_name,table_name,policy_name,command;" > supabase/tests/fixtures/definer_policy_exprs.txt
